title: Signal: Dependency declared with a bare wildcard range
scope: A package.json file that declares a dependency specifier of `*`, which accepts every version the registry has ever published.
limitations: It matches a dependency specifier of `*`, which accepts every version the registry has ever published in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A manifest that documents the wildcard in a README or a fixture is not reported.
